rows.title: The "Rocky Statue" on the steps of the Philadelphia Museum of Art in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, are a huge tourist attraction. Vistors line up, sometimes for blocks, for a chance to photograph the iconic statue, or themselves in it in a "selfie." The 72 stone steps before museum entrance ecome known as the "Rocky Steps" as a result of the scene from the 1982 film "Rocky III" in which star Sylvester Stallone trains for a boxing match by running up and down the stairs. Stallone himself commissioned the bronze statue, by A. Thomas Schomberg
